      • getPart

        public Document getPart(int index)
                 throws General
        Returns a simple document data of a "Root Document". It represents the result of one analyzer method called for the document before. The Engine.getRootDocument() method returns a so-called Root Document that contains the results of all methods called for the current document.
        Parameters:
        index - The ordinal number of the document part.
        Returns:
        The document part.
        Throws:
        General
